styles.name: Automatic / reference guided
styles.description: Resolve an explicit artistic cue when present; otherwise preserve supplied references or use a readable flat-vector default.

instructions.materials: When visual references are supplied, infer and preserve their approved material response instead of assigning a new material. Without references, use the resolved supported default.
instructions.forms: Retain the reference proportions and silhouette; simplify only unresolved tiny shapes so the whole subject stays recognizable in the selected cells.
instructions.linework: Match the approved source contour language, whether stepped, painted or smooth; keep its thickness and edge treatment consistent across the full sequence.
instructions.shading: Use the reference shading logic and light direction without introducing new shadows or highlights between states; a text-only default uses simple color planes.
instructions.palette: Preserve required colors and reference markings; never infer a replacement brand palette or select a chroma key by recoloring the approved subject.
instructions.texture: Reuse visible reference texture at a scale that reads in the final cell; pin its distinctive motifs and seams to the same surfaces in all poses.
instructions.rendering: Choose a supported direction consistent with the user concept: pixel for stepped grids, plush for stitched fabric, clay for sculpted material, painterly for brushwork, or flat-vector for clean graphic forms. Approved references control the final technique; lock it in the canonical base review.

negative_constraints: Do not average incompatible reference styles or silently restyle imported artwork.
Do not treat automatic selection as visual proof or introduce background scenes.
limitations: Automatic textual matching cannot inspect source pixels; reference-guided runs require an explicit canonical-base art-direction review.

compatibility.scaling: Inspect the actual approved medium before selecting resampling; use nearest for stepped grids and filtered resampling for continuous edges.
notes: Actual reference materials may require a different extraction filter; inspect alpha and key collisions before state generation.

styles.name: Brand inspired
styles.description: Translate attributed approved brand cues into an original compact character while preserving explicit requirements and identity.

instructions.materials: Translate an approved brand material cue into a simplified surface such as matte product plastic, woven workwear or soft coated paper; use only cues present in the retained brief.
instructions.forms: Build original rounded or angular character masses from the approved product personality; keep recognizable reference proportions and avoid reshaping an existing imported mascot.
instructions.linework: Use a single contour system informed by approved graphic guidance, such as even monoline or broad rounded outlines; freeze this choice at the canonical base.
instructions.shading: Favor a small consistent highlight-and-shadow vocabulary suitable for the approved brand finish; keep every light and reflected shape inside the character.
instructions.palette: Apply retained approved brand colors only where explicit character requirements allow; maintain their hierarchy and contrast without inserting logos or lettering.
instructions.texture: Use one restrained surface motif derived from attributed guidance; make it large enough to survive reduction and keep repeat placement stable through animation.
instructions.rendering: Create a readable original mascot from approved public or user-provided colors, themes and tone. Keep researched inferences attributed and subordinate to explicit constraints; avoid logo copying and readable brand text unless explicitly approved.

negative_constraints: Do not invent brand facts, palette approvals or source attribution.
Do not copy a logo, add branded text or claim official affiliation without an explicit request.
limitations: Brand guidance does not establish permission or visual consistency; record sources and review original character identity.

compatibility.scaling: Inspect the actual approved medium before selecting resampling; use nearest for stepped grids and filtered resampling for continuous edges.
notes: Actual reference materials may require a different extraction filter; inspect alpha and key collisions before state generation.
